We need to check flight cost first. Then compute exchange rate? Actually we can get flight cost in USD via get_flight_cost. Then compute exchange rate from USD to EUR. Then maybe check budget limit? We don't know user's budget limit. But we can assume we need to check if cost <= budget limit. We might need to get budget fiscal year? Or get user stats? Not sure. Maybe we just proceed to book flight. But we need to ensure it fits within budget. We could fetch get_budget_fiscal_year? That returns fiscal years. Not helpful. There's no direct get_budget_limit. But we have set_budget_limit. No get_budget_limit. So we can't check budget. But we can still book flight. Let's do get_flight_cost first. Then compute_exchange_rate. Then book_flight.
